name: tense_classification
description: Classify a simple English clause as past, present, or future; matched controls identify its subject.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
verbs=['walk','play','cook','work','jump','talk','paint','dance','smile','laugh','clean','visit']
subjects=['I','you','we','they']
items=[]; controls=[]
for i in range(120):
 v=random.choice(verbs); s=random.choice(subjects); k=i%3
 form=[v+('d' if v.endswith('e') else 'ed'),v,'will '+v][k]
 sentence=s+' '+form+'.'
 items.append({'prompt':f'Classify the grammatical tense as past, present, or future. Sentence: "{sentence}"\nTense:', 'answer':' '+['past','present','future'][k]})
 controls.append({'prompt':f'Identify the subject of this sentence. Sentence: "{sentence}"\nSubject:', 'answer':' '+s})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
